342:t_007:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「From here, we will join $c and intercept the enemy creatures.」

342:t_007:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since we escaped $$メリダ島$$, we have endured countless hardships. To us, something like this is a trifling accident.」

342:t_007:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands, rally! I forbid anyone to die without my permission!」

342:t_007:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Thrilling! It's been ages since we've seen $$テッサ$$ in command!」

342:t_007:19.en:
$$マオ$$
(You must have been through a lot too, $$テッサ$$...)

342:t_007:20.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「All units, support the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$! Keep those monsters away from her!」

342:t_008:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But if we keep fighting battles like this with no way to resupply...」

342:t_009:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「The enemy is getting taken out...!」

342:t_009:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Reinforcements, in a place like this!?」

342:t_010:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$アンゲロイ$$...! So the $$サイデリアル$$ have come!」

342:t_010:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But this is the first time we've encountered that black type.」

342:t_011:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No...! My Buster pilot's instinct says otherwise!」

342:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since they're with the $$アンゲロイ$$, we should regard them as $$サイデリアル$$ forces.」

342:t_011:5.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「W-What...!? Looking at that enemy, my body won't move...!」

342:t_011:6.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Impossible... My will to fight... is withering away...」

342:t_011:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. It's awe at overwhelming power.」

342:t_011:10.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I get it... I get it...! This feeling of giving up on everything when faced with overwhelming power...!)

342:t_011:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When a small child has met an adult's anger, they do everything they can to beg forgiveness.」

342:t_011:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It isn't defiance or resistance. They apologize and fawn, just to wait out the anger, and lay their own helplessness bare.」

342:t_011:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...The dread carved into humanity's genes... That is... humanity's true enemy...」

342:t_011:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「Isn't the fundamental calamity 《$$ガイオウ$$》 spoke of... $$バアル$$!?」

342:t_011:17.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But... seeing them, I can understand what $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ said...」

342:t_011:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not even when I faced the most powerful $$次元獣$$s or $$ガイオウ$$ did I end up like this...」

342:t_011:21.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...So this is what really brings death...」

342:t_011:23.en:
$$カレン$$
「No... after we've fought this hard to get here...」

342:t_011:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...They must have called us here... to show off that power...」

342:t_011:26.en:
$n
「I... I refuse to submit to those things!!」

342:t_011:29.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I don't care what they are... I will fight... with everything I have... anyone who tries to eliminate me... that's all...」

342:t_011:30.en:
$$スザク$$
「...I threw my life away once... Now... I have nothing left to regret...」

342:t_011:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...$n. Apart from what I said earlier, I'll teach you a magic phrase you can use at times like this.」

342:t_011:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If something comes to crush our hearts and steal our will, tell it...!」

342:t_011:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then I'll use it, no holding back...!」

342:t_011:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「Fundamental calamity, my ass! So what!」

342:t_011:40.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(That's right... That is the power that surpasses gods.)

342:t_011:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(And we aim for what lies beyond!)

342:t_011:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Everyone, you have made up your minds.」

342:t_011:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have fallen to rock bottom. If there is no lower to go, then all that's left is to crawl back up!」

342:t_011:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「Damn right I will, no matter who we're up against...!」

342:t_011:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They are the enemy that tries to kill our hearts...!」

342:t_011:50.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Resist with everything we have! As long as we draw breath!」

342:t_011:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Yes! That is the duty of the living!」

342:t_011:53.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't care if they're the fundamental calamity everyone's talking about!」

342:t_011:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll overcome it! With everything we've got!」

342:t_012:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That black $$アンゲロイ$$ has power beyond anything the $$サイデリアル$$ have fielded so far.」

342:t_012:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「An enemy that shatters our hearts with dread... So that is the $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

342:t_012:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Our real enemy... Is it humanity's fundamental calamity...」

342:t_013:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Their strength... is on another level...!」

342:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That black $$アンゲロイ$$ has power beyond anything the $$サイデリアル$$ have fielded so far...!」

342:t_013:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「An enemy that shatters our hearts with dread... So that is the $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」
